images.alt: Cartoon of a tramper who is trying to cross farmland, but she is blocked by an angry bull standing on the other side of the farm gate. The caption reads "The bull hadn't checked WAMS to know he's blocking an unformed legal road."

post.text:
There is a lot of public access in NZ that is only visible on our public access maps, WAMS. Explore public access in NZ: www.herengaanuku.govt.nz/types-of-access
If you think you are being accidentally blocked from walking on publicly accessible land, contact one of our regional field advisors.

source.agency_name: Herenga ā Nuku Aotearoa (Outdoor Access Commission)
source.notes: Public AT Protocol profile and posts can be captured without live-posting side effects.
